## setting

*Materials and Methods, 'Plant Material, Fungal Inoculation, and Sampling'*

> Maize inbred line B73 was grown at the Central Crops Research Station near Clayton, NC plots as described by Shu et al. (2015). Maize ears were hand-pollinated and covered with paper bags until inoculation at 21-22 days after pollination. [...] For each treatment three ears randomly selected from the 70 plots were harvested at 4, 12, 24, 48, and 72 hpi.

## sampling_selection
**45 run(s)** — rule `stat-NA418364-sel` — 10.3389/fpls.2017.02075  
*Materials and Methods, 'Plant Material, Fungal Inoculation, and Sampling'*

> Inoculation was conducted by wounding the kernel with a 3 mm needle bearing approximately 13 conidia (Dolezal et al., 2014; Figure 1a). Kernels for the mock treatment were inoculated with sterile distilled water containing 0.05% (v/v) Triton X-100.
